jobs.title: Brand Protection Specialist (SEO)
jobs.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Brand Protection Specialist (SEO) based in United Kingdom.

This is an opportunity to play a key role in protecting a global digital brand and its intellectual property across search engines and online channels.
You will monitor the web for unauthorized content, investigate potential infringements, and coordinate effective enforcement actions.
The role sits at the intersection of SEO, digital brand protection, copyright, and online compliance.
You will work closely with Legal, Marketing, and SEO stakeholders to identify threats and protect branded search visibility.
The position offers a high degree of ownership, requiring strong research skills and the ability to independently resolve complex online cases.
You will collaborate with external platforms and service providers, including domain registrars, hosting companies, and web-security providers.
This fully remote role is well suited to a detail-oriented, proactive professional who enjoys investigative work in a fast-paced international environment.

jobs.title: Backend QA Engineer
jobs.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Backend QA Engineer based in United Kingdom.

Take ownership of quality across a high-traffic, backend-focused platform where reliability and precision are critical.
You’ll combine hands-on manual testing with automation to validate APIs, transaction lifecycles, data, and event-driven services.
The role gives you the opportunity to uncover edge cases and risks beyond what is explicitly defined in specifications.
You’ll work closely with engineers and other stakeholders to ensure robust releases and prevent critical issues from reaching production.
Your work will span REST and gRPC APIs, relational databases, message queues, and distributed backend services.
You’ll also contribute to automated regression coverage using Go and help continuously strengthen the testing approach.
Working fully remotely within a global team, you’ll have meaningful ownership in a fast-growing technology environment.


Accountabilities
  • Analyze business requirement

MoonPay Enterprise is for builders with something to prove.

This isn't a "work on cool crypto stuff" company. It's a high-standards, high-velocity, high-accountability company building the operating system for value movement. jobs.title: iOS Software Engineer
jobs.description:
About ActAI

There are over 5 billion users using basic applications today such email, notes, tasks, calendar and they're not AI-native. Our mission is to build proactive applications for anyone in the world, who are not used to complex prompting. We aim to bring intelligence to conversations, errands, organising and workflows, with minimal to no prompting.

Our product focuses on achieving high reliability for long-running workflows, persistent context, and real-world task completion. We believe products will greatly reduce hallucinations.

Our objective is to organise anyone's life, allowing us all to spend time on valuable and meaningful things.

 

Role

As an iOS Software Engineer, you own the iOS client experience, how AI feels, responds, and performs in users’ hands. This is not a thin integration role. You will build a production-grade iOS application where AI interactions are central to product experience, and performance, reliability, and user trust are critical.
